work_info.title: What is Real Estate Editing?
descriptions: Real Estate Editing is a specialized digital enhancement process that transforms property images into polished, market-ready visuals. By refining lighting, perspective, and color balance, it helps listings stand out, attract potential buyers, and convey the true value of a property.

list.content: Perspective Correction: Adjusting angles and lines to ensure architectural accuracy and visual appeal.
Color & Light Enhancement: Balancing exposure, brightness, and color tones for natural, eye-catching images.
Background Cleanup: Removing distractions and clutter to focus attention on the property.
Virtual Staging Support: Integrating digital furniture and decor for better visualization.
Shadow & Reflection Refinement: Adding realistic depth and dimension to interiors and exteriors.
